note: Canonical state machines. README.md is generated by tools/check_design.py --write. A machine names either a proto enum or an immutable-source non-wire stored state map; enum pseudo_states and response_only do not apply to stored maps. Transitions leaving a terminal state must be marked reopen.

initial_guards.RUNNING: kind = ADOPTED; successful explicit HUMAN adoption records the synthetic task and its one ADOPTED attempt together

transitions.guard: budget, pool, global limits (03 section 4); kind != ADOPTED

transitions.guard: peer policy (no entitlement: LAN is free, AD-0015); kind != ADOPTED

transitions.on: offer declined or expired; transfer failed before start
transitions.effect: re-placement; any side-effect class

transitions.guard: pause SUPPORTED and task pausable; kind != ADOPTED
retry rules allow (AD-0006 section 4) and attempts remain; kind != ADOPTED

transitions.on: attempt finished non-zero, timed out, OOM, CPU limit or termination incomplete
attempt LOST (boot changed, container missing, peer lease ended)
transitions.guard: not retryable; for ADOPTED, its attempt is RUNNING or STOPPING and the boot changed or adoption container cannot be reopened

transitions.on: TaskService.CancelTask; session ended (stop_with_session); node shutdown for kill_with_node

transitions.effect: new attempt number

transitions.on: explicit cancellation of the adopted container completed
transitions.guard: kind = ADOPTED; adoption container is empty
transitions.effect: one attempt FINISHED with CANCELLED/HAPPENED; no retry
one attempt FINISHED with LOST/UNKNOWN; no exit status and no retry

transitions.effect: commit STOPPING with the pending cause and redacted detail before applying the platform stop; a restart continues that stop (architecture 04 sections 6 and 9)

transitions.on: completion evidence is available (exit record or platform completion); a fast root can exit before RUNNING is published

transitions.on: container empty, or verification window (5 s) elapsed

recovery: container missing, boot changed, or peer lease ended
transitions.effect: termination LOST; effect UNKNOWN
transitions.guard: for ADOPTED, only RUNNING or STOPPING; boot changed or adoption container cannot be reopened

transitions.on: TaskService.CancelTask requests termination of the adopted container
transitions.effect: record and journal STOPPING in the cancel command; no command launch or managed end steps
termination CANCELLED; effect HAPPENED; no captured exit code, output or managed FINALIZING phase
termination LOST; effect UNKNOWN; node is not the parent and has no exit status

machines.title: Node browser sign-in (cloud side)
machines.persisted: cloud fleet_node_sign_in.state; node mirrors as SignInFlowState

transitions.guard: this account reviewed the flow (GetNodeSignInFlow) within the last 10 minutes, else STATE/invalid_state not_reviewed; a proved step-up of class fleet.approveNodeSignIn bound to the flow ID, consumed in the approval's transaction; the node cap admits one more node, else RESOURCE/quota_exceeded max_nodes_per_account; an absent approve is refused (approve: required, a center rule)
transitions.effect: one-use code issued (32 random bytes, stored as a digest, valid 2 minutes by default and never past the flow); the approving session and its epochs stored; the reply is the redirect to the stored loopback URI with code and state

transitions.on: NodeEnrollmentService.ApproveNodeSignIn approve again by the approving account, before the one-use code is redeemed
transitions.effect: a new one-use code replaces the unredeemed one

transitions.guard: this account reviewed the flow within the last 10 minutes; no step-up
transitions.effect: the reply is the redirect to the stored loopback URI with error=access_denied and state

transitions.on: NodeEnrollmentService.ApproveNodeSignIn deny by the approving account, before the one-use code is redeemed; or the approving account's IdentityService.RevokeAllSessions or RemoveAuthIdentity
transitions.effect: the unredeemed code is void

transitions.on: NodeEnrollmentService.CompleteNodeSignIn with the correct code, verifier and node key proof
transitions.guard: the code is compared first, in constant time; the one-use code has not expired (a correct code presented after its lifetime is STATE/expired, consumes nothing and leaves the flow APPROVED); the approval has not lapsed and Enroll admits the node
transitions.effect: installation registered (Enroll); node credentials issued

transitions.on: NodeEnrollmentService.CompleteNodeSignIn with the correct code and a wrong verifier or node key proof
transitions.effect: the code is redeemed; the reply is AUTHENTICATION/unauthenticated

transitions.on: NodeEnrollmentService.CompleteNodeSignIn with the correct code presented again (reuse)
transitions.effect: the credential family the flow delivered is revoked; the reply is CONFLICT/code_reused (also for any later presentation)

transitions.on: 10 minutes elapsed (derived when the row is read, not written); or a newer BeginNodeSignIn of the same node ID and the same node key

10 minutes elapsed (derived when the row is read, not written); or CompleteNodeSignIn with the correct code, verifier and proof finds the approval lapsed (the approving session revoked by the account, with its device or by an operator, an epoch of it moved, or the account not Active; a sign-out or an expiry of that session does not lapse it)
transitions.effect: nothing of the enrollment remains; the reply is STATE/expired

machines.title: Device authorization (headless sign-in)
machines.persisted: cloud fleet_device_authorization.state

transitions.guard: this account looked the code up (LookupDeviceCode) within the last 10 minutes, else STATE/invalid_state not_reviewed; a proved step-up of class fleet.approveDeviceCode bound to the normalized user code; the node cap admits one more node, else RESOURCE/quota_exceeded max_nodes_per_account; an absent approve is refused (approve: required, a center rule); on the /activate page the typed last group of the node key's fingerprint matches, checked before any step-up evidence is consumed (else VALIDATION/invalid_argument fingerprint_tail: mismatch)
transitions.effect: the approving session and its epochs stored

transitions.guard: this account looked the code up within the last 10 minutes; no step-up

transitions.on: NodeEnrollmentService.ApproveDeviceCode deny by the approving account, before the credentials are delivered; or the approving account's IdentityService.RevokeAllSessions or RemoveAuthIdentity
PollDeviceAuthorization with the device code and a valid node key proof delivered credentials
transitions.guard: the poll is not early (a poll sooner than its interval less 500 ms is answered SLOW_DOWN and delivers nothing); the approval has not lapsed and Enroll admits the node
transitions.effect: installation registered (Enroll); node credentials issued. A later poll with the device code and a valid proof is a reuse: the authorization stays COMPLETED, reused_at is set once, the delivered credential family is revoked, and the reply is COMPLETED without credentials

transitions.on: 600 s elapsed (a poll records it); or a newer StartDeviceAuthorization of the same node ID and the same node key

600 s elapsed (a poll records it); or the delivering poll finds the approval lapsed (the approving session revoked by the account, with its device or by an operator, an epoch of it moved, or the account not Active; a sign-out or an expiry of that session does not lapse it)
transitions.effect: nothing was issued

transitions.on: a signed-in node has an enabled CloudLink ticket
authenticated WebSocket upgrade, connection-bound NodeHello proof and ChannelAccepted
credential rotation sends TokenRefresh on the same connection
transitions.guard: the new token is of the same center, session family, node and installation; the center rechecks the credential and center.nodes gate

transitions.effect: 4401 refreshes the node credential before retry; 4500 may supply a bounded reconnect hint; normal jittered backoff is 1 to 60 s

transitions.on: backoff or a link change wakes the loop
close 4403 or reserved 4503, or an upgrade refusal for feature, plan or account state
one hour elapsed, a later credential rotation, or a link change wakes the loop
transitions.effect: a rotation during the refused attempt does not trigger an immediate retry

transitions.on: cloud link disabled, sign-out or node credential unavailable

machines.title: Center-routed Submit and Cancel record (AF-CTR-05)
machines.persisted: PostgreSQL fleet.routed_call.state with delivered and final_at; not the historical RemoteCommandState wire enum. A final record may be resent under the same command ID without changing its final state; a comparable node result is checked against the recorded outcome digest

transitions.on: verified EXECUTED result with a value
transitions.effect: final; a verified comparable resend is checked against the recorded node outcome digest

transitions.on: verified EXECUTED result containing the TaskService handler error
transitions.effect: final only for an effect that happened; DID_NOT_HAPPEN remains nonfinal

transitions.on: verified node refusal of the attempt
transitions.effect: final only when its effect is not DID_NOT_HAPPEN; a prior possible delivery stays UNKNOWN
final only when its effect is not DID_NOT_HAPPEN; an expired call never executes late

transitions.on: an attempt that may have reached the node has no verified result, the node reports UNKNOWN, or the next lease-holder sweeps an unsettled ACCEPTED record
transitions.effect: never conclude the effect did not happen; a later no-effect refusal cannot erase an earlier possible delivery

transitions.on: no attempt has reached the node and this call could not be sent
transitions.effect: DID_NOT_HAPPEN; not final

transitions.guard: record not final; same digest and live target; a possibly delivered record remains inside its replay window; fresh account step-up when required
transitions.effect: a new attempt routes its own unchanged inner bytes; node command deduplication protects the original command ID. A final record may also be resent without changing its state or outcome; a comparable result is checked against its recorded digest
